title: fails the step when the image or the copy is refused, after running both, and hands the spec no app
why: The check's exit status dropped: a Release whose app is not notarised is recorded as one that is, and the gate goes on to test it.

title: holds a signed image to the Developer ID checks, image first then the copy
why: The Developer ID checks never reached: a signed Release is recorded on the strength of the ad-hoc check, which any valid signature passes.

title: records a tag built with signing off as the ad-hoc build it is
why: The release config alone taken to mean a signed build: a candidate cut while signing was off, before there was a certificate, fails its own gate.

title: fails the step where Gatekeeper will not come on, before any check
why: Gatekeeper's status after not read: the checks run on a runner that accepts everything, and their verdicts are the machine's setting, not the build's.

title: turns Gatekeeper on before the checks where the runner has it off
why: A runner that comes with assessments off fails the gate for its own setting, which says nothing about the Release.

title: warns when signing is on now and the tag was built without it
why: An unsigned tag accepted in silence while signing is on: a release meant to be signed and built with the variable off is recorded as ad hoc, and nobody is told to look.

find: and the copy as Notarized Developer ID. The app is opened
replace: and the copy as notarised. The app is opened
title: records each build in the words docs/releasing.md quotes
why: The record reworded in the workflow alone: the release procedure tells the maintainer to look for a sentence no run writes.

title: fails an unsigned image whose app is not signed ad hoc, whatever the tag
why: The app in an unsigned image taken for ad hoc unread: one signed with a certificate, or not signed at all, is held to no Developer ID check and recorded as an ad-hoc build.
